title: Accepted rule change creates a new conflict
item: agent-spec: an accepted rule change can create a new rule conflict with no owner turn left to settle it
motivation: Seen in switch-base-5; the conflict is listed on the policy page as an open decision, so the gates pass
notes: Decide whether the answer step gets one more owner turn.
done_means: The owner decides whether the answer step gets one more owner turn. Then a seeded trial with such a conflict ends with it settled or put to the owner, not only listed.
draft_note: Becomes an iterate task once the owner has decided.
